verdict.rationale: A free tier with a published storage quota is a fair question for a document storage and collaboration service like SharePoint, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents the REST and Graph APIs and webhooks but never mentions a free tier, a no-cost plan or a published storage quota. Community items refer only to paid licensing, not to any free offering.

support.subject: As a power user, I can start free — a real free tier with published storage quota that works with the same clients and API
